import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_shift_difference
  {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ N : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, N ≤ x → ∀ h ∈ Set.Icc 0 B,
        dist (f (x + h) - f x) 0 < ε := by
  intro B hB ε hε
  let δ : ℝ := ε / (B + 1)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    positivity
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hf) δ hδ
  refine ⟨max 1 N₀, ?_⟩
  intro x hx h hinterval
  rcases hinterval with ⟨hh0, hhB⟩
  have hx1 : 0 < x :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (le_max_left 1 N₀ |>.trans hx)
  have hxh : x ≤ x + h := by
    linarith
  have hxph : 0 < x + h := by
    linarith
  by_cases hh : h = 0
  · simp [hh, hε]
  · have hhpos : 0 < h := lt_of_le_of_ne hh0 (Ne.symm hh)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hderiv⟩ :=
      exists_deriv_eq_slope (f := f) (a := x) (b := x + h)
        (by linarith)
        (hfd.continuousOn.mono (by
          intro y hy
          rcases hy with ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
          exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx1 hy1))
        (hfd.mono (by
          intro y hy
          rcases hy with ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
          exact lt_trans hx1 hy1))
    have hcN : N₀ ≤ c := by
      have hNx : N₀ ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_right 1 N₀) hx
      exact le_trans hNx (le_of_lt hc.1)
    have hderiv_bound : dist (deriv f c) 0 < δ :=
      hN₀ c hcN
    have hderiv_abs : |deriv f c| < δ := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hderiv_bound
    have hden : x + h - x ≠ 0 := by
      linarith
    have hcalc : f (x + h) - f x = deriv f c * h := by
      rw [hderiv]
      field_simp [hden]
      ring
    rw [hcalc, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_mul]
    have hB1 : h < B + 1 := by
      linarith
    have habs : |deriv f c| * h < δ * (B + 1) := by
      calc
        |deriv f c| * h < δ * h :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hderiv_abs hhpos
        _ ≤ δ * (B + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hB1) (le_of_lt hδ)
    dsimp [δ] at habs
    have hratio : ε / (B + 1) * (B + 1) = ε := by
      field_simp
    simpa [abs_of_pos hhpos, hratio] using habs

import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_shift_difference
  {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ N : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, N ≤ x → ∀ h ∈ Set.Icc 0 B,
        dist (f (x + h) - f x) 0 < ε := by
  intro B hB ε hε
  have hden : 0 < 1 + B := by
    linarith
  have hsmall : 0 < ε / (1 + B) := div_pos hε hden
  have hderiv_small :
      ∀ᶠ y : ℝ in Filter.atTop, |deriv f y| < ε / (1 + B) := by
    have hball := hf.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) hsmall)
    refine hball.mono ?_
    intro y hy
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_sub, sub_zero] using hy
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hderiv_small
  refine ⟨max N (1 + B), ?_⟩
  intro x hx h hmem
  have hxN : N ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_left N (1 + B)) hx
  have hx1B : 1 + B ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_right N (1 + B)) hx
  have hxpos : 0 < x := by
    linarith
  rcases eq_or_ne h 0 with rfl | hne
  · simpa using hε
  have hpos : 0 < h := lt_of_le_of_ne hmem.1 (Ne.symm hne)
  have hsubset_cc : Set.Icc x (x + h) ⊆ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro y hy
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hxpos hy.1
  have hsubset_oo : Set.Ioo x (x + h) ⊆ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro y hy
    exact lt_trans hxpos hy.1
  have hcont_restrict : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc x (x + h)) :=
    hfd.continuousOn.mono hsubset_cc
  have hdiff_restrict : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo x (x + h)) :=
    hfd.mono hsubset_oo
  have hxlt : x < x + h := lt_add_of_pos_right x hpos
  obtain ⟨c, hc_mem, hc_deriv⟩ :=
    exists_deriv_eq_slope (f := f) (a := x) (b := x + h)
      (hab := hxlt) (hfc := hcont_restrict) (hfd := hdiff_restrict)
  have hdiff_eq : deriv f c = (f (x + h) - f x) / h := by
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hc_deriv
  have hinc : f (x + h) - f x = h * deriv f c := by
    rw [hdiff_eq]
    field_simp
  have hc_ge : N ≤ c := le_trans hxN (le_of_lt hc_mem.1)
  have hbound : |deriv f c| < ε / (1 + B) :=
    hN c hc_ge
  have hprod : h * |deriv f c| ≤ B * (ε / (1 + B)) := by
    exact mul_le_mul hmem.2 (le_of_lt hbound) (abs_nonneg _) hB
  have hBlt : B < 1 + B := by
    linarith
  have hstrict : B * (ε / (1 + B)) < ε := by
    calc
      B * (ε / (1 + B)) <
          (1 + B) * (ε / (1 + B)) :=
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hBlt hsmall
      _ = ε := by
        field_simp
  have habs : |f (x + h) - f x| = h * |deriv f c| := by
    rw [hinc, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hpos]
  have hgoal : |f (x + h) - f x| < ε := by
    calc
      |f (x + h) - f x| = h * |deriv f c| := habs
      _ ≤ B * (ε / (1 + B)) := hprod
      _ < ε := hstrict
  simpa [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using hgoal

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_shift_difference
  {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ N : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, N ≤ x → ∀ h ∈ Set.Icc 0 B,
        dist (f (x + h) - f x) 0 < ε := by
  intro B hB ε hε
  let C : ℝ := ε / (B + 1)
  
  have hC : 0 < C := by
    dsimp [C]
    positivity
  
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in Filter.atTop, ‖deriv f y‖ < C := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun y => ‖deriv f y‖) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using hf.norm
    exact (tendsto_order.1 hlim).2 C hC
  
  rcases (mem_atTop_sets.1 hev) with ⟨N, hN⟩
  refine ⟨max N 1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx h hh
  
  have hx1 : 1 ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hx
  have hxpos : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hx1
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ h := hh.1
  
  have hdiff : ‖f (x + h) - f x‖ ≤ C * ‖(x + h) - x‖ := by
    apply Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le
      (s := Set.Icc x (x + h))
    · intro y hy
      apply hfd.differentiableAt
      exact isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds (lt_of_lt_of_le hxpos hy.1)
    · intro y hy
      exact le_of_lt (hN y (le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx) hy.1))
    · exact convex_Icc x (x + h)
    · exact left_mem_Icc.2 (le_add_of_nonneg_right hnonneg)
    · exact right_mem_Icc.2 (le_add_of_nonneg_right hnonneg)
  
  have hnorm :
      dist (f (x + h) - f x) 0 = ‖f (x + h) - f x‖ := by
    simp [dist_eq_norm]
  
  rw [hnorm]
  calc
    ‖f (x + h) - f x‖ ≤ C * ‖(x + h) - x‖ := hdiff
    _ = C * h := by
      rw [show (x + h) - x = h by ring, norm_of_nonneg hnonneg]
    _ = ε / (B + 1) * h := by
      rfl
    _ = (ε * h) / (B + 1) := by
      ring
    _ < ε := by
      apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < B + 1)).2
      nlinarith [hh.2]
